install_habitat_core: install the habitat core package by running python setup.py install without the --all flag
install_habitat_full: install the full habitat package with baselines by running python setup.py install --all
develop_habitat_core: install the habitat core package in editable develop mode by running python setup.py develop
develop_habitat_full: install the full habitat package with baselines in editable develop mode by running python setup.py develop --all
review_optioned_command: review the OptionedCommand class that adds the --all user option to setuptools install and develop commands
